title: Node: an `execFileSync` inside `Promise.all` freezes every other task — their timeouts fire late and look like failures
summary: Synchronous child-process calls block the event loop for the child's whole run. Concurrent async work, including timers that implement timeouts, cannot run until it returns, so unrelated checks in the same Promise.all appear to time out.

sources.title: Node.js child_process: synchronous process creation
sources.note: The synchronous methods block the Node.js event loop until the spawned process exits.
